intro.text: One of Vathi's trusted advisors, who greets a reluctant Dusk outside the government offices.
Soil, Vathi's vice president, who brings her the results of the votes on her people's future.

items.text: Soil met Dusk outside the government offices before the talks with the Ones Above.
He brought Vathi the telegram with the latest vote. As each vote's margin grew narrower, he came to think they should accept the provisional terms of the Ones Above.
As vice president of the interior and Vathi's trusted advisor, he often acts as her aide, fetching Dusk for talks, discussing strategy, passing on messages and seeing off guests and diplomats.

appearance.text: Long-legged and lanky, he carries his Aviar on his head rather than his shoulder, a sight the broadsheets love to caricature.

personality.text: A city man, he knows little of the jungles of the Pantheon.
